meta.title: Kiwi Guingueta · Beach bar on the Passeig Voramar
meta.description: Beach bar at Passeig Voramar, 5, Vilanova i la Geltrú, right by the sand. Drinks, tapas and sunbeds for a day on the beach. Phone: 620 18 72 58.
meta.ogAlt: Kiwi Guingueta, beach bar in Vilanova i la Geltrú

hero.eyebrow: Passeig Voramar · Vilanova i la Geltrú
hero.title: A bar right on the sand
hero.lede: Cold drinks, tapas and sunbeds to hire. A beach bar on the Passeig Voramar where you go from towel to table without putting your shoes on.

strip.label: Practical information
strip.orderValue: At the bar or on WhatsApp

roast.title: Everything you need for a day at the beach
roast.lead: What brings people back is the combination: a cold drink, simple food and a sunbed near the water.

menu.title: What there is to drink and pick at
menu.lead: A short menu built for the sun: drinks, tapas and dishes you can eat with one hand.

m1.name: Drinks and cocktails
m1.note: Cold, for the sun, with or without alcohol.

m2.name: Tapas and small plates
m2.note: To pick at without leaving the towel for long.

m5.name: Coffee
m5.note: On the beach too, once the sun drops.

menu.note: No prices on this page: ask at the bar or on WhatsApp.

reviews.title: What people say after a day here
reviews.lead: Extracts from Google reviews by customers of the beach bar.

visit.title: How to get here
visit.lead: At Passeig Voramar, 5, next to Vilanova beach. If you come by car, park on the promenade and walk down to the sand.
